description: Ground V3KTR has traveled. The topographic view buffers each feature by properties.radius_m, or by default_radius_m when that is null. Fog covers everything outside those buffers. Coordinates are display meters, [east, north]. Example features stay hidden unless the page is opened with ?demo=1. Do not invent a path. Schema: id, example, world, radius_m, date, source, notes. See the README.

properties.notes: Dragons Lair Base, the Eden origin. The sheet clears the default radius around this visited point. The radius is not a surveyed boundary.
EXAMPLE. Hidden demo track for ?demo=1. Not a path V3KTR walked. It crosses the example grass polygon so the sheet can be checked.
